group.item: 3D Printer
Make Lenny Print some Resumés
Well at least I still have my cave to sleep in.
Quit complaining, bro! A cave is luxury accommodations!
I once survived a whole winter with no more shelter than a single pine needle!
I stayed warm with vigorous calisthenics. If I'd stopped for a minute, I'd've froze to death.
I was President at the time. People don't like to imagine their leader doing jumping jacks for three long, desperate months in twelve feet of snow, but this happened. Swear to God.
You'll take it? Great!
With this sale, I'm moving up the property ladder! Goodbye cave and hello hovel!
I do love celebrating America with a 4th of July camping trip to one of our national parks.
That's why I created the park system, bro! You're welcome, America!
Wow. Teddy Roosevelt. 26th President of the United States and a famed naturalist.
Yup, I love nature all right. Now let's go shoot the biggest animal we can find and eat it raw. Nothing puts hair on your chest like moose carpaccio.
4th July Giveaway
Seems like you could do with some help in setting up your own Fireworks display! Happy 4th of July!
008: License to Whack
Collected Whacked Snakes
10 Leagues Under Squidport
Reach Level 15 and Build Squidport
Make Old Sea Captain Reminisce
Send Yellow Submersible Down Under
The yellow submersible found something, it did! Let's see what we got!
I didn't think anything was down there except the bodies of the many, many men I've killed.
You technically found it, so finders keepers! Keep sending the Yellow Submersible on missions and see what it finds!
Arr, a yellow submersible. An old first-mate and I used to sing our love of submersibles which be yellow.
Then one day, he gathered up our lyrics and chord changes and dashed off to Liverpool, England.
I wonder whatever became of him and those music publishing rights.
15 Minutes of Shame Pt. 1
Make Lloyd Journal Apocalyptic Thoughts
Darn, yet another apocalypse didn't come to pass. Us preppers just can't catch a break.
I had so many plans for the post-apocalyptic hellscape: shaving my hair into a mohawk, wearing all leather, instituting a Beanie Baby-based currency…
I should stop talking to myself before people start thinking the guy-who's-rooting-for-society-to-collapse is crazy!
I'll just write my thoughts in my journal. Now, which Beanie Baby notebook should I use…
Wow, I feel like I emptied my head of everything that was in there. Better go to Moe's to fill it back up with cheap booze.
15 Minutes of Shame Pt. 2
Make Lloyd Choose a Publisher
Look at all these pages! Writing's sorta like prepping for the apocalypse, but instead of gathering canned beans and ammo, you just gather your thoughts…most of which are about ammo.
Have you ever thought about getting a publisher and making this into a book?
Of course I have! Half the reason I got into prepping was to make my way into the literati!
Oh, so you don't need our advice?
Only thing I need is to decide which publishing house I'm gonna go with: Simon & Shooter, Random Bunker, Doubledoomsday, HarperShut-ins…
Boy, these prepper publishers sure know how to moonshine and dine a fella!
15 Minutes of Shame Pt. 3
Make Lloyd Have a Photo Shoot for the Book
Well, which publisher did ya go with? Lemme guess: you decided to self-publish.
No way! I'll risk being self-sufficient when society falls, but I need professionals to get this book into as many stores as possible.
I went with Oxford University Press. Those cutthroat psychos will get this book on more shelves than a prepper's jars during pickling season.
So, what's next? You work with an editor to get your book in perfect shape?
Nah, they got people to do that for me. I have to work on something far more important: my photo for the book cover!
15 Minutes of Shame Pt. 4
Make Lloyd Meet With Fans
Make Springfielders Get Books Autographed
I really wanted my true self to show, so I went with this photo of me looking pensive riding a motorcycle while smoking a pipe and writing with a quill pen.
Ah, the understated look. Wearing two monocles was a nice touch, too.
There he is, the author of “Thus Prepped Zarathustra”!
Lloyd! Lloyd! Sign my book!
This book is brilliant! Where do you get your ideas?!
Same place I get everything else: from inside my windowless bunker!
15 Minutes of Shame Pt. 5
Make Lloyd Prepare for the End
*sigh*
What's the matter, Lloyd? Weren't PREPARED for the downside of fame?
“Downside”?! Fame's great! Money, adulation, all the canned beans I could eat!
But I made the classic prepper mistake: I confused my own thoughts with the plotline of Kevin Costner's post-apocalyptic masterpiece “The Postman”.
My book has been recalled for copyright infringement and I'm being sued by Warner Bros. Their lawyers are more vicious than any band of blood-thirsty, nomadic marauders.
They even took my monocles. Suddenly, the end of the world doesn't seem so bad. Guess I'll get back to preparing for it…
28 Years Later Pt. 1
Place the Future Simpson House
Get Mooch Bart
Collect Chronons
Our future house looks a lot like our current house.
Yeah, I don't do a lotta maintenance.
At least you replaced your skateboard with a hoverboard.
That's my hover ironing board!
Ahhh, here I am at my own house in the future.
Hey Homer.
Bart?! It's time for you to move out! You're older than me now!
Then it's time for YOU to move out.
Him have point.
28 Years Later Pt. 2
Place the Astro House
That place looks interesting. Let's go in and check it out.
If it requires going up stairs, count me out.
Maybe it has an elevator.
Those only go down for me.
28 Years Later Pt. 3
Place The Newfangled Kwik-E-Mart
Oooh! A futuristic Kwik-E-Mart! I wonder what wares they sell.
Same crapola as before.
Yep! This future jerky is from 1973.
All jerky is from 1973! That's the only year jerky was made.
Mmm, vintage jerky.
28 Years Later Pt. 4
Place the Cryogenics Facility
We're in the future for sure. I can tell from all the people tubes and suicide booths and cryogenic facilities.
Sounds suspiciously like an episode of Futurama.
It's a robot! Kill him!
Bite my shiny metal ass!
That's not licensed for this game! I'm suing myself!
28 Years Later Pt. 5
I wonder what Lisa's up to in the future? I hope she's got a respectable job, like celebrity spokesmodel or talk-show doctor.
She's President of the United States.
What a disappointment.
Let's kidnap the Commander in Chief and send her to a time-out!
28 Years Later Pt. 6
Get President Lisa
30% Chance of Kaboom
Make Springfielders Door-Crash on Black Friday
So dad, did you get your free doohickey from Krusty Burger after waiting in line for hours?
Yes. Yes I did.
Well, where is it?
I chucked it in the bin Behind Kwik-E-Mart.
What?! Why?!
It was a Krusty Doll! What do I need a doll for? I'm a grown man!
That's not what you said when they were giving away free McBain action figures after the 'incident' at the set…
Yes, but action figures come with moveable parts. And action. Not that I could expect a GIRL to understand the difference…
*Sigh*
What do you mean ‘the dolls are defective’? They look and act exactly the same as all the other dolls we’ve hocked to unsuspecting customers!
Well, Krusty… Technically speaking, they aren’t just defective; they actually come with a 30% chance of explosion and/or spontaneous combustion.
Quit jerking me around lawyer-guy! Do you know how hard it is to find decent child labor these days? And that’s just for the explosive parts!

Look Krusty, this batch of dolls is simply unsellable. I’m afraid the only way we can safely dispose of these is to blow them up in some secret location, preferably deep in the heart of the Nevada desert.
What the heck is this? A Tom Clancy novel? Why don’t we just give them away for free on Black Friday?
That *could* work. But only if they come with a Certificate of Authenticity and an ironclad liability waiver.
STEP RIGHT UP! The Krusty Burger Black Friday Spectacular Krusty Doll Fun Sale is about to BEGIN! Today only! For adults only! But not in a hubba-hubba way!
What? I love free stuff! Oh no, there’s a line forming already! Out of my way bozos!
OY! No skipping to the front of the line ya schlub! Queue up for your trampling just like everyone else!
99 Luft-Word-Balloons Pt. 1
Make Springfielders Tap Away their Thoughts
Make Homer Tap Away his Thoughts
Make Database Bask in his Achievement
I feel honored people are--
Tap.
People are enjoying what I—
Tap.
Made. The greatest achievement is the joy—
Tap.
Oh lord, what have I—
Tap.
Hey, what's going on? How come I can read me saying, “Hey, what's going on?”
I can read what you said too, Homer.
And I can read what I'm saying right now! That means, youz alls can read my speak-a-ma-goos.
Ew boy. If a bartender can't curse out patrons under his breath, his mind will snap like a twig.
Don't be afraid.
I've just hacked the code of our universe - which is definitely a real thing - to show all of you exactly what you say.
SHUUUUUUUHB?!
Exactly!
Abstract guttural noises. Nonsense phrases doubling as slang. Strained pop culture references.
Now do you see how much pointless speech fills your lives?!
I've always known that. But you don't see me being a jerk about it.
Self-awareness may be painful, but it's also an opportunity to grow.
Having to see and read what we say will force us to confront how we treat each other. This will spur us on to improve ourselves.
Counterpoint: Texting.
I'm not sure Springfield has enough room for these yap yap bubbles. The town's borders are, ahm, a tad inflexible.
And now that you know I know, please stop sending me comments about it.
Oh, just tap on what's said and you can send it away—
Tap!
Ooooooo!
Now how do I get rid of the “Ooooooo”?
Uh… what's it that I gotta do again?
Today marks the 200th update for The Simpsons: Tapped Out! For this momentous occasion, the Truck Truck Truck is now available for free!
Need a place to put that Truck Truck Truck? How about this free Parking Lot Lot Lot?
Still not enough? Fine, take these 30 free donuts!
3:10 to Yo Yo Pt. 1
Make Yo Yo Give Kangee a Snack
3:10 to Yo Yo Pt. 2
Make Yo Yo Bound Around to Find Worm Train
3:10 to Yo Yo Pt. 3
Make Yo Yo Avoid Grampa
3:10 to Yo Yo Pt. 4
Make Yo Yo Escape Cletus
3:10 to Yo Yo Pt. 5
Make Yo Yo Give Springfield Another Chance
7200 oz Squishee Placed
Congratulations on your purchase of the seventy-two hundred ounce Squishee.
By breaking the seal on the oversized scoop straw, you agree that Kwik-E-Mart cannot be held responsible for any damage caused by brain freeze.
Please drink responsibly. Thank you! Come again!
Aaaayyyyyyyyy!
Make Snake Comb his Bitchin' Hair
A Baffling Ordeal Pt. 1
Make Ned Shop for a New Bible
I came in here looking for a pack of gum and I ended up with six shopping carts full of junk!
I’m guilty of gluttony, coveting, and taking too many free samples from the Swedish meatball lady!
I need to get my head on straight.
Excuse me, underpaid employee-orino, could you point me in the direction of the Bible aisle?
Sure, it’s between the hubcap-sized communion wafers and the Shrine-Sol Pulpit Polish.
A Baffling Ordeal Pt. 2
Make Ned Pray Away His Hernia
Sweet David vs. Goliath, these Bibles are bigger than me!
I guess the Lord is testing my faith and my core strength.
*screams* Oh, my back! And my front!
*chuckles* Sounds like you might’ve given yourself a hernia.
Might want to pick up a few of hernia Bible belts.
Collect Brainulators
Collect Smartwatches
Collect Soy Pops
Collect AR Glasses
A Beautiful Mind Pt. 1
Reach Level 26 and Unlock Wiggum House
Make Leopold Mentor Ralph
Ralph? Have you seen the ingredients for your baking soda volcano?
I suppose I should call a doctor. Where's my phone?
*ring ring*
Leopold, I'm entrusting you with Springfield's best and brightest.
This young man is an artist ahead of his time. He might be the next Dali. After all, he did melt my clock.
Teacher says I'm unteacherable!
A Beautiful Mind Pt. 2
Make Leopold Blow Off Steam
Make Ralph Play With Wiggle Puppy
This boy is impossible to teach, and I once taught Helen Keller slam poetry!
Ralph, let's try this again. If you have six apples, and you give me two, how many apples do you have left?
I don't have any apples.
It's a hypothetical question.
No, it's a fruit.
Just say four. All you need to say is four.
APPLES!
A Beautiful Mind Pt. 3
Make Leopold Take an Angry Walk
Ralph, you're an idiot. There's absolutely nothing happening in your brain.
Buddha says only an empty mind, clear of thought, can achieve true nirvana.
What did you say?
These scissors taste salty.
We're just going to try some fast paced call and response. Ready? The sky is…
Dinosaur!
The earth is…
Dinosaur!
The T-Rex is a…
East Berlin!
Abercrombie & Rich
Unlock Abercrombie & Rich
Build Abercrombie & Rich
Make Marge Go Christmas Shopping
This clothing store is so fashionable. And the staff looks like they jumped right out of a magazine.
Even the mannequins are oo-la-la handsome. And most of them don't even have heads!
I've been browsing all day but I haven't found anything that fits Homer. Even the stretch socks are too much of a stretch.
I'll have to accept that the only six-pack Homie is ever going to have is one pulled from our fridge.
I need to find a gift for Homie. What do you get for the man who's eaten, drank and passed out on everything?
I know for sure he's not picky.
But I would like to find him something unique. Something manly and sexy.
We know exactly where you should shop for the modern over-packed pile of lard.
Collect Holiday Scythes
Collect Souvenirs
Collect Toy Soldiers
Collect Cologne
Abe's in Toyland Intro
Make Death Terrify Grampa
That’d be like taking a girl who’s never been kissed, or a cop who never beat a witness.
Fine, tell your story. I hate people who whine for mercy.
In that case, you picked a heck of a business.
But the fates have decreed you must die before Christmas morn. So no rambling.
Oh, I never ramble.
Hey, everyone, it’s Christmas Eve, and time for my favorite tradition…
Telling you one of my amazing stories of Christmas past.
But first, time for one of *our* favorite traditions…
Going to bed instead of wasting time on one of your rambling stories.
Don't worry Dad, there'll be lots of time for your stories tomorrow.
Like when I’m watching football and ignoring you.
*heads to guest room* Aw, what’s the point of living if no one wants to hear me talk.
Glad you feel that way. Because your time has come, Abraham Simpson!
Abe's in Toyland Outro
Make Grampa Tell How He Dodged Death on Christmas Eve
Congratulations, Abraham. Your story took so long that dawn has come, and your time to die has passed.
You have achieved your goal, and cheated Death myself.
What are ya talking about? I wanna go. This world sucks. I mean, you should see the Retirement Castle where I live.
I have, many times. I’m seeing Jasper there this morning. But you missed your chance.
*climbing out window* Smell ya later!
Aw, nuts. I’m still alive.
Hi Grampa. What are you doing up so early?
Did I ever tell you how I cheated Death on Christmas Eve?
Not another made up story!
Abe the Toy Soldier Pt. 1
Make Grampa Tell Another Wild Tale
Look, you need to hurry up these stories. You’re supposed to be chewing coffin dirt by dawn.
Don’t get your ghoul underpants in a ghost knot, I’m getting there.
World War Two was over. I had an honorable discharge from the Army, and a dishonorable discharge from a skin condition I picked up in Paris.
The economy was booming, and every veteran was dating a nurse he’d kissed on V-J day.
And yet America was threatened by internal Communist subversives from the USSR.
We were headed towards a Christmas nightmare!
I know all about Christmas nightmares.
Abe the Toy Soldier Pt. 2
Make Grampa Model for Whiz-Bang Toys
So there I was in 1950, looking for a job where I could use the skills I learned in the Army.
But there wasn't much demand for potato peelers, despite my vast experience.
Then I got lucky!
Hey there, soldier, I work for Whiz Bang toys.
We’re going to make some Army Man toy soldiers, and I’d like to use you as the model.
We’ll pay you a penny for every thousand soldiers we sell.
Lemme just do the math… aw, too hard. I assume I’ll be rich!
Abe the Toy Soldier Pt. 3
Make Grampa Pose for Reference Shots
Abe, you’re going to be a fantastic model for our Army Man toys.
Now, take this rifle and imagine you’re pointing it at the enemy.
My platoon lieutenant. Got it.
I mean, someone you actually killed.
My platoon lieutenant. Got it.
Abe the Toy Soldier Pt. 4
Make Grampa Keep His Secret
You did a fantastic job posing for those toy soldiers, Abe. You’ve made Whiz Bang Toys very happy.
And you’ve done a great service to your country.
For the first time ever! But how?
I work for J. Edgar Hoover at the FBI. We’re going to use those toy soldiers to root out Communist infiltrators.
Each one of them has a tiny radio transmitter inside. We’ll be able to hear everything that’s going on inside every home in America.
As a patriotic American, can I count on you to keep quiet about this?
Sir, it’s 1950. Which means I still trust the government.
Abe the Toy Soldier Pt. 5
Make Grampa Save America From Intrusive Surveillance
Well, I said I wouldn’t blab about the toys being designed to spy on ordinary Americans.
But it turned out my girlfriend at the time was spying on me for the CIA.
Lots of spying in those days. Anyway, she told her boss, who didn’t like the FBI stickin’ their noses into his business.
They confiscated and melted all the original Army Man soldiers. Whiz Bang had to make a new batch.
Which is why, instead of me, they look like Kirk Douglas.
A Better Mousetrap
Place Homer Decoy
I think someone might be trying to kill me!
Oh Homie, no one wants to kill you… well not fatally any way.
I’m serious Marge. I need a bodyguard.
Maybe you should hire one of those guys that used to protect the President.
A Secret Service agent? I can’t afford their partying lifestyle.
Hello Simpsons. I couldn't help overhearing your conundrum and I have just the thing!
Hey, it’s a decoy me. Now he can go to church while I stay home and drink beer.
What about the threat to your life?
There's a threat to my life? AAAAAAAAH!
A Blimp in a Blimp
Make Homer Blimp Around
I went nowhere, but still got horribly nauseous. *retches*
I love you, free blimp!
I can't believe that getting a blimp in our inventory constituted a legally binding gag order.
Please. Lisa. Everything you've said this update is so hard to understand. You're a kid -- can't you use small words?
Ostensibly.
Plus we got a free blimp! That’s my third favorite form of transportation after fan boat and falling.
You want to take it for a spin?
No, it was a bribe -- I want nothing to do with it. Also, you've been drinking. Also, the blimp's tied down with hundreds of complicated knots.
Yeah, there're a million ways this can go wrong. See you when I get back!
A Bont of Friendship
Make Hank Scorpio Send Homer a Holiday Gift
Hey, look Marge! A thank you gift from Hank Scorpio!
“Dear Homer. As Project Arcturus enters Phase 48, fondly remembering you and your contributions. I hope you and your family are well.”
“Speaking of, try to avoid being within a fifty-mile radius of the Gateway Arch in St. Louis on January 6, 4:00:00 GMT.”
“Also, best to avoid anywhere downwind of that location for whatever the half-life of Mendelevium is. Please accept this gift. Cheers! Hank.”
It's that time of year again. Time to send out a big thank you to a special former employee!
Without his faithful service, and my fusion-fueled, death ray-equipped, rocket escape sled, I might have spent the holidays as Interpol’s prisoner.
Above the Clouds of Springfield Pt. 1
Reach 3.75M Real Estate
Build a Business Center
I propose building the Cookie Kwan Business Center – Develop Your Cookies in this Cookie. And yes, I'm open to throwing a fourth “Cookie” somewhere in the name.
Excellent. We can always do with more useless people locked in a fancy office building doing menial tasks for billionaires who don't give a damn about them.

Upgrade a Business Center to Level 2
Above the Clouds of Springfield Pt. 3

Above the Law Pt. 1
Make Future Wiggum Show Off His Belt
Make Lou Elbow Eddie
Make Eddie Compose Himself
It sure is great to be back in the old Springfield.
Chief, what the heck happened to you?
You look different.
You must be referring to my nifty jetpack belt thingy.
Nah, we can't see your belt under that fat belly of yours—
*coughs loudly*
Yeah, we were referring to your nifty belt that's easy to see around your slim waist.
Above the Law Pt. 2
Make Lou Elbow Eddie Again
Make Eddie Bite His Tongue
Make Future Wiggum Patrol Springfield
You can sleep on the job in the future?
Police work never changes.
These jetpack things are life-changing!
It's amazing that thing can lift you.
Chief, when was the last time you walked?
Walked? Like moving one foot in front of the other? *chuckles* Those days are over.
How do you "walk a beat" in the future?
I don't. Walking is for dummies. This jetpack makes me twice the cop I used to be.
From the looks of you, you're four times the cop.
Thanks, Lou.
Above the Law Pt. 3
Make Future Wiggum Try Walking
Make Lou Look Away in Horror
Make Eddie Look Away in Horror
I forgot how exhausting using legs can be.
But it's healthy for you to move, Chief.
But, I'm sorry to say, not so healthy for you two very shortly.
What are you talking about?
Today is the day you both get killed on the job.
What?! No way. That's crazy future talk.
Chief, what do you know?
It was a freak accident but sometime today I'm gonna faint on top of you. You'll both be crushed beyond recognition.
Can I finish this story later? With all this walking, I'm feeling lightheaded… *starts wobbling*
*takes a step back* Look out! He's comin' down.
We gotta get our chubby Chief back in the air before he stops, drops, and kills!
Chief, we gotta get you back on the ground. This jetpack is not good for you.
I've been in the air so long I don't think I can move like a human anymore.
You won't have to. We have a nice comfy squad car waiting.
And there's coffee and donuts in the front seat.
You make a good case for my return to earth.
Absolutely Crushing It Pt. 1
Make Sentient Lard Lad Statue Do Community Service
Make Springfielders Be Outraged
Sentient Lard Lad, do you acknowledge that you are of sound mind for these court proceedings?
My head is hollow. I have no mind.
I've given the oath to worse. We shall proceed.
Based on the destruction you caused around Springfield, I sentence you to one hundred hours of community service.
*gasp* Community service? That's it?! He crushed my front porch!
He crushed my car!
He crushed my grandmother!
Duly noted. But there are no prisons large enough to hold Lard Lad, so community service will have to do.
Absolutely Crushing It Pt. 2
Make Sideshow Bob Show Lard Lad the Ropes
Make Sentient Lard Lad Statue Learn the Ropes
How did I end up out here on the side of the road picking up trash?
First time in community service, eh?
Is it that obvious?
I'll show you the ropes.
That would be great, thanks.
Here are the ropes. Now use them to tie the trash bags together.
Absolutely Crushing It Pt. 3
Make Sentient Lard Lad Statue Eat Donuts
Make Sideshow Bob Hoard His Lunch
All you had for lunch were donuts?
Donuts are kinda my thing.
I could make them my thing too.
No.
It's time for lunch, chum.
I don't eat lunch. I'm a statue.
That's what the non-statues want you to think.
But I have a hollow head.
You see a hollow head, I see a storage facility for hundreds of lunches.
Okay, I'll eat!
Just stay away from my lunch.
Absolutely Crushing It Pt. 4
Make Sentient Lard Lad Statue Go on a Rampage
Make Sideshow Bob Enjoy the Show
What did he crush this time?
"Crush" is a strong word, your honor. My client will concede to "squish".
Very well. What did he squish?
Your honor, it's beneath the dignity of this court to inquire as to what or who I may or may not have squished.
You squished a "who"?
Your honor since there is no prosecution present, given they've all been squished, I ask that this case be dismissed.
Ah, our "who" was the prosecution. Very well. Case dismissed.
Ugh, how much time do I have left on my community service?
How many hours were you assigned?
One hundred.
So far you've mostly been on a lunch break so…ninety-nine and a half hours to go.
Gaaahhhh!!!!!
A Bull in a Magic Shop Pt. 1
Make Lisa Use Fandom Powers to Annoy Homer
There's even a new district called Charmer's Market in town that panders to everything I'm gushing about. Can we go? Can we? Can we?
No. Not in a million years. Not even if my Dad particles are teleported there and back… No!
But they have a ton of junk food, just with stupid fancy-sounding names.
Sounds stupid-endous! And even dumb-licious!
I still need a wand, robe, an animal familiar, a couple books…
Heck no. I'm not wasting my “I'm-faking-a-sick-day” to take you costume shopping. Halloween is so far away it scares me. Eeeagggh! See. Scared.
But if I don't start work on it now, it'll just be a dumb costume. I need cosplay grade or better this year.
Why are you trying so hard to impress the weird anime kids? And the weirder adults?
If you ever become part of a real fandom, you'll understand.
A Bull in a Magic Shop Pt. 2
Build Charmer's Market
Make Springfielders Pretend They're Wizards
Make Homer Mock Kids and Adult Kids
I'm looking for a Magic Tap Ball doubles partner. Rough touch rules. BYOB: Bring Your Own Broom.
I like my stuffed owls just as ornery as the real ones! And I'm willing to trade my lunch money to procure it!
I cast “AMEX-O” with my dad's credit card to buy a bag of funky tasting jelly beans!
Honey, Bart should've come with us. He'd have a field day making fun of all these freaks.
So, let's get this dress shopping over with. Where to? How ‘bout the nearest computer? You can buy things online, like a normie millennial.
Where's the thrill in that? I need a quest to acquire my robes and wands! The journey is as important as the accoutrements.
That's why we must cross the Magic Station into Charmer's Market!
I'd ask questions about what you just said but honestly, I wouldn't understand your answers.
A Bull in a Magic Shop Pt. 3
Make Homer Drool Over Old Wand
Dad, you can't just take it! That's pick-pocketing, or wand-pocketing, or something.
I'll pay for it. I'm just trying it out in my back pocket to see if it makes my butt look cool.
*snap*
You just sat on it, didn't you?
Yeah, but how's my butt look?
Is this the last store? I can't walk another step unless you can cast a wizard spell on my aching feet.
I promise this is the last stop. Besides, the wand is the most important piece!
You must have a special bond with a wand. It must call to you. Some say it takes years to find a wand that-
*stare* Got it!
A-Caroling We Go, Pt. 1
Collect Donation Sandwiches
Make Mr. Plow Go to Moe's
Make The Plow King Go to Moe's
Make Ned Tag Along to Moe's
Thanks for plowing the street out front, Plowmen. Business hasn't been this good in years.
Hey, Mister Moe, you got any more of that thar high-class drinkin' whiskey?
Oh, yeah, I'll bring some right over to you.
You have high-class whiskey?
For you? No. For the yokel who doesn't know better? Yes. As soon as I drain the pickled egg jar.
Say, fellas, I'm sorry I couldn't be more help. But next time maybe you should ask before you chainsaw the roof off my car and superglue it to the hood.
Stupid Flanders.
My plow died an hour ago. Are either of yours still working?
Mine ran out of gas yesterday, and I hadn't plowed the gas station yet.
The roof fell off the front of my car about an hour into plowing and then Homer buried it when he plowed past me.
I said, "Stupid Flanders." You're not getting any more of an apology than that!
Guess we couldn't keep the roads open, huh? Any other ideas?
We did keep the most important road open. The one that leads to Moe's!
A-Caroling We Go, Pt. 2
Collect Donation Sandwiches
Make Moe Complain to Duffman
Make Barney Try Peppermint Duff

Vandalize a Friend's Building
Mhoyvin! I see you've found my newest invention -- the “Frink Point”!
You'll get one every time you interact with something in other Springfields. With the tapping and the reading and the waiting too long for loading.
What's in it for me?
I’m glad you asked, my good man! Science has learned that interacting with other humans improves your quality of life, it may, in fact, extend your life.
That’s nice, but I’d really rather get some kind of imaginary prize or doodad for doing stuff.
*sigh* Doodads, always with the doodads.
You can now collect Friend Points from your friends and unlock new prizes!
Actually, they're called FRINK points. F-R-I-N-K. Sometimes people mis-hear me ‘cause of my Hoy-vin accent.
Actually, “Friend Points” has a nice ring to it, let’s call it that.
But I’m the inventor, and you’re just some guy. So I think we both know who gets to name the points.
Collect Friend Points today!
Friends of a Seller Pt. 1
Make Homer Continue Making Mirror People
Make Disco Stu Dig It
Make Mirror Disco Stu Throw More Finger Guns
But this isn't God's plan, Homer. What you're doing is sacrilegious.
Don't you mean "sacri-diddly-egious?"
Stop it, Homer, this is serious-a-rino.
*sigh* Doesn't the Bible say that God made man in his image?
Well, yes.
So, I'm just doing his work for him. If anything, he should be thanking me.
Don't get me involved in this.
That'll be twenty dollars, sir. And Homer Inc. thanks you for your business.
Disco Stu is finally going to have a friend who enjoys vinyl as much as him!
Now, when you say "him" do you mean your mirror self or you?
Disco Stu realizes that talking in the third person is extremely confusing in this particular case.
Homer, are you sure it's safe to bring all these mirror people into our world?
It's perfectly fine. Just ask my latest customer.
Mirror Disco Stu…thinks that you…are quite a view. *finger guns*
*chuckles* Oh my. I guess it is perfectly fine.
Friends of a Seller Pt. 2
Make Homer Do Anything Else
Make Ned Lecture Mirror Homer
Make Mirror Homer Be Bored to Death
How much more do you have to say?
I can boil it down to just a few more hours of prayer and self-reflection.
Oh Lord.
That's the spirit!
Look, Ned, I'm not sure about the praying, but I think I might know someone interested in your self-reflection…
Homer, I can't find anywhere in the Bible where it says it's okay for man to duplicate himself.
They're not duplicates. They're alternate universe versions. The Bible must be okay with that.
Well…it might be covered in one of those modern paperback editions.
Look, I've gotta go do…anything else. Talk to Mirror Homer.
You realize that I hate Ned just as much as you, right?
Friends of a Seller Pt. 3
Make Ned Prepare Dinner
Make Mirror Ned Assist With Dinner
Dad, this dinner is delicious.
Yeah, you can really taste the reduced sodium canola oil.
Well, to tell you the truth, it was Mirror Ned here who did most of the cooking.
We're used to new mommies, but does this mean we have two Daddies now?
Heaven forbid! Despite the Supreme Court's permissive shenanigans, he's not your Dad.
I've got my own Mirror Rod and Mirror Todd.
Speaking of which, I need to tuck them into bed, it's almost six p.m.!
Howdy doody, Nedarooni. I hear you're spreading the good word.
You made a mirror version of me?
Why not? Mirror Ned is the only man boring enough to be interested in a man as boring as you.
No time to get bored with the Lord. I have to make dinner for Rod and Todd. It's Fried Fish Friday.
So it is. I've been dying to try a new recipe for butter battered angelfish.
Let's get cooking!
Friends of a Seller Pt. 4
Make Homer Make Mirror Marge
Make Marge Be Nervous
I love what you've done with the place.
Thanks. I just wish the house wasn't so messy.
I'll help you clean up. You know what they say, "happy wife, happy life". *chuckles*
You mean cleaning makes you happy too?
Of course! I'll start by straightening the sailboat painting over the couch.
I do that every week but Homer just knocks it over again when he runs in from the garage to watch TV.
Homer, shouldn't you be at work?
I sent Mirror Homer in my place.
Why was he so willing to go?
Took me by surprise, too.
Do you think all the mirror alternates are willing to do our work?
I know what you're thinking, Marge.
Unless you're thinking of stopping me from making a Mirror Marge…
…then I don't know what you're thinking.
Friends of a Seller Pt. 5
Make Homer Regret Making Duff-beer Floats
Make Marge Get Her Nails Done
Make Mirror Marge Get Her Nails Done
Meanwhile, at the plant…
You wanted to see me, Mr. Burns?
Smithers, who is this man?
It appears to be an alternate version of Homer Simpson, sir. And not just regular Homer in a costume.
I'm the version of Homer that came through his magic mirror.
So, you have a magic mirror that duplicates people, eh? Bring it to me at once!
I dunno… The Mr. Burns in my universe is pretty evil. How do I know I can trust you?
Does your Mr. Burns tap his fingers and say "Excellent"?
Yes.
Then he shouldn't be trusted. And since I revealed that to you, you can trust me.
Oh…okay.
*taps fingers* Excellent.
Marge, I'm hungry. When's dinner?
Sorry, Homer. Mirror Marge and I are getting our nails done. You'll have to find something in the fridge.
All I found is vanilla ice cream and Duff!
Improvise!
Duff-beer floats it is!

Friends Without Benefits Pt. 1
Make Temperance Get Her Bearings
Make Moe Turn on the "Charm"
This future town is so complicated. New buildings appear all the time.
There's a tavern. Perhaps they can give me directions.
Oh, heya Midge. So you finally decided to mix up the wardrobe, eh? Retire the ol' green dress?
Yeah. What's with that getup anyway? Did I miss another Civil War reenactment?
Who's Midge? My name is Temperance. Could one of you fine gentlemen tell me where I am?
Hot diggity, a Marge look-a-like! My Dear Sky Finger letters finally paid off. Time to turn on the ol' Moe charm.
Friends Without Benefits Pt. 2
Make Temperance Explain
Make Moe Get His Hopes Up
Wow, that's quite a tale. It's like it came from one of those… Ah you know, that things wit all dem words in it. Kinda heavy… Barney, help me out here.
Uh, a talkative sumo wrestler?
Forget it. So anyway, since your husband ain't here, you wanna go out on a date?
A date?! I'll have you know that, unlike my husband, I take my marital vows very seriously!
Whoa, temper, temper Temperance. Look, a date with me is just two people talking. There ain't nothin' romantic about it.
My apologies. In that case, a date would be fine. But you're sure this isn't something intimate?
Most definitely. *picks up phone* Hello? Gilded Truffle. Reservation for two, please… Yeah, the dark part of the joint.
Look no further for assistance, madam. This here is the fine town of Springfield. And uh, where might you be from?
I hail from the island of Nantucket.
Well don't you worry, Moe here will be your guide.
You are Moe? Your name is on the sign outside. You are the proprietor of this establishment?
Well, technically with the foreclosure…it's complicated.
I see…
But yeah, I'm Moe. So, uh, you gots a boyfriend?
Well… it's complicated…
I see…
Friends Without Benefits Pt. 3
Make Temperance Enjoy the Aphrodisiacs
Make Moe Take Out a Loan for Dinner
Did yous enjoy the meal?
I certainly did. The food in this town is fantastic. Well, it's getting late. Would you mind walking me home?
Well, you see the thing is, around here it's normal after a meal to go look at the stars. Under a blanket. And just talk.
It is? I see. Well, when in Rome…
Yeah sure. But again, this is Springfield.
This restaurant is fancy, but I'm worried it may be too romantic. The napkins look like little swans and when they face each other they form a heart!
No, that's not romantic. It's a cardiovascular warning from the health department. Yeah, that's it. They're very strict. So, you ready to eat?
I am rather hungry, but I don't recognize most of the items on this menu. What is "couple's fondue"?
Oh, that's just a meal with two long forks where youse feeds each other. It's, uh, very professional.
Huh, well I'm a little out of my element. Would you mind ordering for me? I just want to admire all these candles surrounding our table.
Sure thing. Uh, waiter, I'll have the caviar and she'll have the oysters. And another bottle of wine please. You know, the businessman's special.
Friends Without Benefits Pt. 4
Make Temperance Gaze at the Stars
Make Moe Gaze at Temperance
This place is lovely. What's the name of it again?
Tongue-Kiss Point. But don't pay no attention to the name, it's French and doesn't translate to English right.
Don't look now, but there's a couple cuddling over there.
My goodness! I tell you, some people just ain't decent.
Makes you wanna…maybe try out what they're doing just so you can…ya know, understand the depths of their, uh…their indecency.
I think I can see the depths of it just fine from here.
Yeah, me too. Total depths.
Friends Without Benefits Pt. 5
Make Temperance Call for Her Husband
Well, thank you for a lovely evening, Moe. This town may have some strange traditions, but it's good to know it's got decent people in it, like you.
Aw shucks, Temperance. Tonight wasn't anything special…
Just a completely normal non-romantic date that'll probably make me have to miss my rent payments for the rest of the year.
Perhaps we can do this again sometime?
Only if Barney pays his full bar tab.
Moe, do not think me forward but, upon our first farewell, my husband and I shared a goodnight kiss. Do you think that would be proper?
I sure do!
Good. Then I'll send him right out. Good night!
Frinkenstein's Baby Monster Pt. 1
Make Baby Frink Play Tiny Mad Tinkerer
Scientifically speaking, which is how I always speak, there's no logical explanation for me talking to a baby version of myself.
Then logically, there must be an illogical explanation.
Your logic is ironclad… and I only wish your diaper were as well. We must run a series of experiments with the switches and the beakers and the kaboom in the face.
…Thereby determining whether you're my spawn, a clone, a robot, or one of the thirty-seven other illogical possibilities.
Plus, it'll be fun!
Affirmative.
Frinkenstein's Baby Monster Pt. 2
Make Baby Frink Try Not to Change Timelines
There's only one logical illogical explanation. I've gone back in time to when I was just a young bloygler!
I was afraid of that. And also of monsters under my crib. Whatever we do, we must prevent me from doing or touching anything that might disrupt the space-time--
Yes, yes, the space-time continuum, everybody knows about that! Just shut up and start not disrupting it.
Frinkenstein's Baby Monster Pt. 3
Make Baby Frink Ponder the Unknowable
Oh no, we've made a terrible mistake! It was YOU who went back in time, not me! So YOU were supposed to not disrupt the space-time continuum!
Oh Gloyd! If I disrupted anything, anything at all, then I don't exist anymore!
True. But since you do exist… hello?
Hello?
Eh, he probably just went to the store to get me some baby food, because if I starve to death then he won't ever exist.
Hello?

Make Marge Relax in the Pharaoh Tent
It's full of frogs! What kind of a crazy beach club is this?
“CABANA” IS A SPANISH WORD!
Sorry. Couldn't hold out any longer.
Ooh! I didn't realize the Egyptians had such lovely cabanas!
“Cabana” isn't exactly the right-- you know what? Enjoy it.
I don't see any beach towels in there. I guess no one reserved it for the day.
Just stop talking, Mom. I don't know how much longer I can go without correcting you.

Why do you hate me?
I’m going to barf on you.

Kill me, please.

From Links to Links, Pt. 1
Make Club President Bildorf Spread the Good Word of Golf
Make Wiggum Try to Understand Rehabilitation
So you're not going to try and commit more crimes?
Trying is the plan, yes.
Okay…crimes are what keep me in business.
Ahh, Springfield Junipers Golf Club — a welcome sight after the last two years.
Hey, you. Bildorf!
Hello, Chief Wiggum.
Aren't you supposed to be in prison? I'm pretty sure that's where I sent you.
I have served my time and been released.
Is that how prison works? The criminal justice system surprises me all the time.
I am a changed man. My time behind bars has shown me that material wealth is fleeting. Real wealth lies in the good book…
…the Pocket Guide to Golf!
From Links to Links, Pt. 2
Make Lovejoy Explain Religious Disinterest
Make Jesus Christ Wander Into the Church
Make Club President Bildorf Be Distracted by Jesus Christ
…and with multiple heavenly entities floating around Springfield, people don't seem to care that much anymore.
Aside from Ned Flanders.
Hey, Lovejoy! Up high…and mighty!
*high fives Jesus Christ*
And down low…where the devil goes!
*down low fist bump*
Jesus Christ?
In the blessed flesh!
So Jesus Christ is wandering around Springfield and people don't care about religion anymore?
Go figure, huh? Thank God for the Ned Flanders' of the world. He's still up in my grill.
And thankfully outta mine.
Bildorf, you're back. I heard you'd been arrested for behavior of the deviant sort at that golf church of yours.
It was all just a big misunderstanding.
What brings you to my church this sunny Sunday? Shouldn't you be out on your course?
I stopped in to see your congregation but only see empty pews.

Retreat!

Willie? Is that you?
Aiee! The balls are callin' to Willie, and ah haven't even had me breakfast whiskey!
Willie, it's Seymour. I'm stuck in the vent and need help. You have two options…

*rolls into view*

After ten minutes of my struggling, she told me that she needed to go sit down, as the laughter had winded her.

About 16 gills.

Now gnaw through this bag.
